title: PXAPI analysis run request v1
description: The accepted request an Analysis Run was created from. It records what was asked for and under which operating mode the requester claims to be authorised — and nothing more. It is not an authorisation decision: owner verification, access control, URL reachability, egress and SSRF policy, robots handling and scanner execution policy are all enforced by the slices that own them, and a valid document here proves none of them. The request carries opaque references rather than personal data: no name, no e-mail address, no credential and no delivery destination.

schema_version.description: Required. Always 1.0.0 for this contract. Each contract is versioned in its own right; this value is not a version of the contract set as a whole.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this request started. It is the link to that run's state document.

request_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this request artifact itself, distinct from the run it started.

requested_at.description: Required. When the request was accepted, in UTC.

target_url.description: Required. The website the run was requested for, as a structural URL shape only. That a value validates here says nothing about whether it may be fetched.

scan_mode.description: Required. The operating mode the run was requested and authorised under. PUBLIC_NON_INVASIVE is what any visitor could observe; OWNER_VERIFIED_CONTROLLED is the mode that presupposes a verified site owner. The vocabulary is closed and case-sensitive, and the member is mandatory: a run whose authorised mode was never stated is not a valid request. Recording the mode is not performing the verification it names.

requester_ref.description: Optional. An opaque reference to the requesting identity, resolvable only by the system that issued it. Absent means the request is not attributed to a stored identity. It is a reference, never a name, an e-mail address or a credential.
